blocks.arabic_text: حَرْفاً مِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ فَلَهُ بِهِ حَسَنَةٌ وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا لَا أَقُولُ الم حَرْفٌ وَلكِنْ اَلِفٌ حَرْفٌ وَلَامٌ حَرْفٌ وَمِيمٌ حَرْفٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح غريب باب ما جاء في من قرا حرفا ...رقم:٢٩١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: .”For the one who recites the Qur'an, one good deed is given in return for each letter. One good deed is equal to ten good deeds. I do not say that Alif, Lam, Mim all together are one letter. Rather, Alif is one letter, Lam is one letter and Mim is one letter,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said (these make three letters; so thirty good deeds will be received).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: تَعَلَّمُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَاقْرَءُوهُ فَإِنَّ مَثَلَ الْقُرْآنِ لِمَنْ تَعَلَّمَهُ فَقَرَأَهُ وَقَامَ بِهِ كَمَثَلِ جِرَابٍ مَحْشُوٍّ مِسْكاً يَفُوحُ رِيحُهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَثَلُ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَهُ فَيَرْقُدُ وَهُوَ فِي جَوْفِهِ كَمَثَلِ جِرَابٍ أُوكِيَ عَلَي مِسْكٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن باب ما جاء في سورة البقرة واية الكرسي رقم:٢٨٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) has narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Learn the Qur'an and keep reciting it. Whoever learns the Qur'an and keeps reciting it, and also continues to recite it in Tahajjud Salah, his example is like an open bag filled with musk. Its fragrance spreads everywhere. The example of one who learned the Qur'an and memorised it but slept without reciting it in Tahajjud Salah is like a bag of musk with its mouth tied up”.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The Qur'an is like musk, and the heart of the Hafiz is like the bag containing the musk. Therefore, the Hafiz who recites the Qur'an is like an opened bag of musk, and the one who does not recite is like a closed bag of musk.
